headline: A custom AI receptionist that works with Zenoti.

howItWorks.body: Zenoti provides an API to retrieve available slots for a service booking. Prestique connects the agent to that API so it can look up open slots when a caller asks.
howItWorks.title: Checks availability in Zenoti

howItWorks.body: The agent answers calls when your team can't: after hours and when the line is busy. Anything the agent shouldn't handle goes to your team with a summary of the call.
howItWorks.title: Answers when your team can't

howItWorks.body: Every call is recorded with a transcript and a summary of what the caller needed. The agent can also follow up by text message after a call. The agent only does what Zenoti's API allows and what you have approved it to do.
howItWorks.title: Keeps a record of every call

intro: Prestique builds custom AI voice and text agents for small businesses. Where Zenoti offers an API, Prestique connects the agent to it so the agent works from the same information your team sees.
You keep Zenoti. The agent works with it rather than replacing it. You control what the agent says and does, and changes are made when you ask for them.
